ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to Finance majors, Actuarial Science majors, and MAS students thru April 18. Any remaining seats will open to other College of Business students on April 19. Some seats held for ACES Agri-Finance majors. Ag-Fin students should notify their advisor of desire to register. Prerequisites will be enforced.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Accountancy or Finance or Business Administration or Actuarial Science major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
